oral_examination.oral_examination: *46 Wedge-shaped deep groove in the neck of the tooth, neat edges, smooth and hard surface; deep into the middle layer of dentin; soreness on the probe, soreness caused by cold water stimulation, no percussion pain, no difference in the gums *18 Vertical elongation, caries, mesial Food impaction, gingival papilla redness, swelling and congestion. Sensitive to cold stimuli. Nothing special.

source_handle: *46 After caries removal, the middle layer of dentin is reached, the cavity is trimmed, 3m of the eighth generation adhesive is applied, 3m of nano resin is filled, mixed and polished *18: Local povidone-iodine disinfection, infiltration with 4% articaine anaesthetization. After the anesthesia takes effect, the gums are separated, the teeth are loosened, and the tooth extraction forceps are removed. Routinely scratch the tooth extraction wound and apply pressure to stop bleeding.
